content.title: Sonos (SONO) Losses Worsen, Valuation Premium Challenges Bullish Narratives
content.summary: Sonos (SONO) remains unprofitable, with net losses worsening at an annual rate of 61.2% over the past five years. The company’s price-to-sales ratio of 1.4x appears high compared to the broader US Consumer Durables average of 0.6x. Shares currently trade at $16.64, which is well above an estimated fair value of $8.55. Without clear signs of improving profitability or growth, investors are weighing high valuation levels against a risk profile that shows no signs of near-term earnings...

content.title: Sonos (NASDAQ:SONO) Missed Q3 EPS Expectations; Stock Drops
content.summary: Audio technology Sonos company (NASDAQ:SONO) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 12.7% year on year to $287.9 million. Its GAAP loss of $0.31 per share was 29.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Sonos: Fiscal Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SONO) on Wednesday reported a loss of $37.9 million in its fiscal fourth quarter. On a per-share basis, the Santa Barbara, California-based company said it had a loss of 31 cents. Losses, adjusted for stock option expense and restructuring costs, were 6 cents per share.
